auto_tint.heading: Auto window tint

auto_tint.footnote: Full vehicle means the side and back glass. The windshield top strip and the sunroof are separate lines. Front doors darker than 35% are not offered. Nevada law, NRS 484D.440.

items.question: Is the price on this page what I will pay?
items.answer: It is where your job starts. Your vehicle and your glass can move it, so we confirm the exact price with you on a short call.

items.question: Why do some prices say Call for a quote?
items.answer: We only post a price the shop has confirmed. Where a number is not posted yet, one short call gets you the exact price for your vehicle or home.

items.question: What changes the price of car tint?
items.answer: Mostly how much glass you cover and the size of your vehicle. Old film to remove, tricky rear glass, convertible tops and damaged defroster lines can move it too. A windshield top strip or a sunroof is priced as its own line.

items.question: How much is windshield chip repair?
items.answer: Call us with the number of chips and where they sit on the glass, and we will give you the price. We check every chip before we repair it.
items.answer_when_published: The first chip is {chip_repair_first} and each additional chip is {chip_repair_additional}. We check every chip before we repair it.
items.template_note: Use answer_when_published ONLY when both chip prices pass priceFor() in production mode (status confirmed AND publish true). Fill the tokens from each entry's display field. The FAQPage JSON-LD must carry the same answer the page shows.

items.question: Do you charge for a quote?
items.answer: No. Quotes are free. Call or text us Tuesday to Saturday, 9 to 5.

items.question: Can I see the shade before I decide?
items.answer: Yes. Build your tint on this site to see each window on screen, then ask to see the film on your glass at the shop. Light, interior color and factory glass all change the real look.
